Position : Operations Manager

Salary : AU $1,000 - 1,200 per month

Working Hours & Conditions : AU Working Hours and Holidays

Employment: Independent Contractor

About the Role

We are looking for adetail-oriented Construction Estimator / Virtual Assistantto support an Australian construction business with estimating, administration, supplier coordination, and project support.

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare construction estimates, quotes, and quantity take-offs.
- Review drawings, plans, and project specifications.
- Obtain and compare supplier/subcontractor pricing.
- Maintain estimating spreadsheets and project documentation.
- Assist with tenders, variations, and cost tracking.
- Coordinate with suppliers, subcontractors, and clients.
- Handle general administrative tasks, emails, scheduling, and data entry.
- Experience inAustralian construction estimating or administrationpreferred.
- Ability to read construction drawings and understand building materials/trades.
- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Strong English communication skills.
- Organised, reliable, and able to work independently.
- Experience with estimating software such asBluebeam, CostX, Buildxact, Groundplan, or similaris a plus.
